tldr: Venus through the 11th house softens friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When Venus moves through your 11th house, it draws your attention toward friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

You may notice what feels wanted, valuable, pleasurable, attractive, or worth protecting. It can help you see what you actually want to choose, keep, enjoy, or repair.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for choosing the pleasant answer because the honest one would ask more of you. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

Venus moves through this house for a few weeks. Let ease show you what you value. Just do not confuse comfort with truth.
